It's no secret that Donald Trump only looks out for himself, but this week, a
[bombshell report ](https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-
security/2026/08/10/trump-flew-secrecy-amid-iran-threat-air-force-one-became-
decoy/https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-security/2026/08/10/trump-flew-
secrecy-amid-iran-threat-air-force-one-became-decoy/)from the _Washington
Post_ underscored just how expendable even those closest to him _really_ are.
As **Swin** [laid out](https://zeteo.com/p/moronic-trump-thinks-its-funny-he)
in **' First Draft,'** Trump left Marco Rubio, Scott Bessent, and Stephen
Miller, along with the White House press corps, as human shields in a plane
the administration claims was the subject of an Iranian assassination threat.
(There's also a question about the Israeli-provided _unverified_ intel about
the threat itself, as **Mehdi**[ explained in ](https://zeteo.com/p/did-
israel-fake-the-iran-threats)**[' First Draft'](https://zeteo.com/p/did-
israel-fake-the-iran-threats) **this morning.)

We wish we could say such stories still surprise us.

Meanwhile, in democracy news, Trump-endorsed election denier MyPillow CEO Mike
Lindell [lost](https://www.npr.org/2026/08/11/nx-s1-5928394/2026-minnesota-
governor-primary-election-lisa-demuth-mike-lindell) his gubernatorial primary
in Minnesota, while another Trump-endorsed election denier, Tom Tiffany,
[secured](https://www.democracydocket.com/news-alerts/election-denier-tom-
tiffany-wins-wisconsin-gop-nomination-for-governor/) the Republican nomination
for governor of Wisconsin. Trump still refuses to rule out declaring a
national emergency to take over the midterm elections. And ICE is planning to
spend up to $20 million for agents to use [electric shock
gloves](https://apnews.com/article/ice-electric-shock-
gloves-016e15e31c5dac5cc253d32b4734dd2a).

That's not all that happened this week - another bombshell report shed light
on a [terrifying
investigation](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/08/13/us/politics/dhs-inquiry-
immigration-protests-minnesota.html) the Trump admin conducted into left-wing
groups. Here's just a taste of how Trump and his allies harmed democracy,
undermined the Constitution, and hurt societies worldwide this week:

#### **Saturday, Aug. 8 - Former Trump Lawyer Confirmed as Attorney General**

The Senate [narrowly voted](https://apnews.com/article/senate-blanche-
attorney-general-justice-department-fcb4157d45d7b13a05de4d2b0f4f92e2) to
confirm Trump's former criminal defense lawyer Todd Blanche as attorney
general.

As acting attorney general, Blanche
[greenlit](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/08/us/politics/trump-todd-blanche-
attorney-general.html) the second indictment of former FBI Director James
Comey, [reauthorized](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/apr/24/doj-
death-penalty-firing-squad-lethal-injection) the use of firing squads for
death penalty executions, and [signed
off](https://www.justice.gov/opa/media/1441086/dl) on a now-supposedly
[rescinded](https://x.com/DAGToddBlanche/status/2084114427813437897) $1.776
billion "anti-weaponization fund."

#### **Sunday, Aug. 9 - Trump Crypto Company's Curious $100 Million
Investment**

The _New York Times_
[reported](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/08/09/us/politics/bobby-zhou-trump-
crypto.html) that a businessman once under investigation in the UK for money
laundering became one of the biggest buyers of tokens from Trump's
cryptocurrency company, spending $100 million through a newly formed firm.

As much as three-quarters of the money ultimately went to a company controlled
by Trump and his sons.

#### **Monday, Aug. 10 - Trump Left Government Officials, Reporters as Human
Shields**

The _Washington Post_ [published](https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-
security/2026/08/10/trump-flew-secrecy-amid-iran-threat-air-force-one-became-
decoy/) a bombshell report that Trump hid in a catering container and was
secretly shuttled into a different plane when leaving Turkey last month, in
response to what the administration claims was an Iranian assassination threat
against the president. (Israel provided the intel about the threat - intel
U.S. officials could not independently verify.)

While Trump switched planes, he left key officials, like Secretary of State
Marco Rubio, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, and White House deputy chief of
staff Stephen Miller - along with reporters in the White House press corps -
aboard Air Force One, which effectively became a decoy.

#### **Tuesday, Aug. 11 - ICE Wants Agents To Use Electric Shock Gloves**

AP [reported](https://apnews.com/article/ice-electric-shock-
gloves-85ff746d3e0ee5f39e7a9a3f1f576252) that ICE, an agency already
[known](https://www.brookings.edu/articles/ice-expansion-has-outpaced-
accountability-what-are-the-remedies/) for its use of excessive force, is
planning to spend up to $20 million to give its agents electric shock gloves
to use as part of its enforcement operations.

The manufacturer says the gloves shouldn't be used on children, pregnant
people, or elderly or disabled people.

#### **Wednesday, Aug. 12 - Top Trump Propagandist to Leave White House**

On Truth Social, Trump
[announced](https://truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump/posts/117084211457388624)
that White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt is leaving her post by the
end of August, but will remain as one of the president's "top outside
advisors."

Leavitt, the youngest press secretary ever, welcomed multiple [far-
right](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nr0Fl2kaj_w)
[content](https://www.thedailybeast.com/maga-podcaster-tim-pool-goes-full-
suck-up-in-first-white-house-briefing/)
[creators](https://x.com/PressSec/status/1956720318384324719?lang=en) into the
"new media" seat at press briefings, [lashed
out](https://x.com/Acyn/status/2011872598549020793) at a reporter during an
exchange about the killing of Renee Good, and
[argued](https://x.com/Acyn/status/1948080549966528579?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw%7Ctwcamp%5Etweetembed%7Ctwterm%5E1948080549966528579%7Ctwgr%5E253a1308d8c7ea8b8a397ad7fce22d729a86e732%7Ctwcon%5Es1_&ref_url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.latintimes.com%2Fwhite-
house-demands-reporters-pulitzer-prizes-stripped-perpetuating-hoax-587457)
that reporters who won Pulitzer Prizes for their coverage of Russian
interference in the 2016 presidential election should be stripped of their
awards.

#### **Thursday, Aug. 13 - DHS Investigated Left-Wing Groups After Pretti's
Killing**

The _New York Times_
[reported](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/08/13/us/politics/dhs-inquiry-
immigration-protests-minnesota.html) that the Department of Homeland Security
quietly launched an investigation into several left-leaning political
organizations in the wake of Alex Pretti's killing by federal immigration
agents.

The probe [targeted](https://apnews.com/article/minnesota-immigration-
enforcement-progressive-groups-investigated-5e6e554e79980553c3a02ca199593a7d)
many groups and individuals who weren't connected to any criminal activity,
and involved expansive surveillance efforts, including infiltrating group
chats on Signal, as well as obtaining financial records of organizations.

#### **Friday, Aug. 14 - Trump Takes White House Ballroom Fight to Supreme
Court**

Trump
[asked](https://assets1.cbsnewsstatic.com/hub/cms/prod_cms_alt/file/2026/08/14/e271a436-0d8b-4806-9a44-b8b222fdf8b8/26a203__1_.pdf)
the Supreme Court to clear the way for his White House ballroom to continue
construction before an appeals court ruling halting above-ground work on the
project goes into effect on Aug. 21.

The Trump administration argues the injunction that blocked the construction
"threatens the security and safety" of the president.
